description: Commerce Assurance: submit one period with its payment, receipt and refund records. The signed close pack totals the period by counterparty, by tool or service and by category, each net of the refunds tied to it, lists the exceptions (payments with no receipt, duplicate payments, unmatched refunds, refunds larger than their payment, records outside the period) and closes with a plain summary. Records-based: live wallet activity is wever_wallet-statement. Verdict ready_to_close or exceptions_to_resolve. POST /api/expense-close-pack. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no counterparty contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/commerce-assurance-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.
